g.text: below threshold, flag for human review
entities, source region and text region
Nothing is discarded. Noise becomes a row —
so the sample can be reported honestly as
forced tool call — name this cluster
(free-form answer is an error, not a fallback)
stays emergent — no label, no screen
The model reads GROUPS, never individual comments.
A subject with 5,000 utterances costs 6 to 10 calls, not 5,000.
